name: Huang Kung-shao
bio: Huang Kung-shao (黃公紹; Huang Gongshao; 13th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 青玉案 (Qing yu an)
poems.author: Huang Kung-shao
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
年年社日停针线。
怎忍见、双飞燕。
今日江城春已半。
一身犹在，乱山深处，寂寞溪桥畔。
春衫著破谁针线。
点点行行泪痕满。
落日解鞍芳草岸。
花无人戴，酒无人劝，醉也无人管。
